summary: Pinned shadcn CLI added official Button and Dialog source to an isolated Vite/React fixture. Production build and browser keyboard behavior passed; axe reported no violations, with one open-dialog incomplete rule. Existing upstream skill symlinks were found at resume, left untouched, and have unknown provenance. No provider settings, MCP registrations, CEOS templates, or global runtime dependencies were changed during this continuation.

The project has a compatible React, styling, alias, and package-manager setup and the generated source has been reviewed.

installation.dry_run_result: Passed. Preview showed src/components/ui/button.tsx and src/components/ui/dialog.tsx; the dry run wrote no component files or package changes.
installation.apply_result: Passed. CLI created button.tsx and dialog.tsx because the Dialog footer's optional Close composition imports Button; it added cn@0.5.0 and radix-ui@1.8.1.
installation.dependency_metadata_limit: At this pinned registry revision, generated Button/Dialog imports include class-variance-authority and lucide-react, but registry npm dependency metadata declares only cn and radix-ui. The fixture pinned cva and lucide-react before invoking add so the result builds.

registry.provenance: At verification time, both official registry file contents matched the pinned source at the recorded revision. Button output was byte-identical. Dialog output matched the CLI's configured Vite transformation: remove the use-client directive for rsc=false and rewrite the internal Button import to @/components/ui/button.

install: Use an existing React project with Node >=20.18.1 and its own styling tokens/configuration.
Install the exact CLI as a local development dependency: npm install --save-dev --save-exact shadcn@4.22.1.
Configure components.json aliases and the CSS file for that project; review its own config before invoking init or add.
Inspect first with ./node_modules/.bin/shadcn add <component> --dry-run --diff --view, then apply with the project-local CLI after reviewing generated source and dependencies.
install_update_rollback.update: Pin a reviewed CLI release and lockfile version. Fetch and inspect the proposed component diff before applying. Back up or commit local component edits before overwrite; components are copied into the project and require deliberate updates.
install_update_rollback.rollback: For this new fixture, remove ~/creative-engineering-os-upstreams/shadcn-ui-fixture to undo it. In a consuming project, restore package.json, package-lock.json, components.json/CSS if changed, and generated component files from the pre-change commit or backup. Remove only docs/integrations/shadcn-ui.md and integrations/evidence/shadcn-ui.json to undo this CEOS record.
install_update_rollback.backups: No private backup was needed: both assigned CEOS output paths and the external fixture were new, and no pre-existing project file or configuration was edited.
install_update_rollback.cleanup: Playwright session and Vite servers were stopped; browser CLI artifacts were moved to the reports directory. The external fixture retains its node_modules and dist build output alongside its source and lockfile; remove those generated directories if a lean fixture checkout is preferred.

supportedAgents: Any shell-capable coding agent working in a compatible React project; npm CLI use was verified.
The upstream Agent Skill is symlinked into Claude, .agents, and OpenCode skill roots; provider runtime discovery was not independently tested.
triggers: Add or adapt an editable React UI component inside an existing compatible project.
Use project-owned tokens, aliases, CSS, package manager, and component source ownership.
updateMethod: Pin a reviewed upstream commit and project-local shadcn CLI version with its lockfile. Inspect each intended component using the local CLI with --dry-run and --view or --diff, review generated imports/dependencies, then apply and repeat build, production browser, keyboard, responsive, and axe checks.
rollbackMethod: Restore the consuming project's package manifest, lockfile, components.json, CSS/config, and generated components from its prior commit or private backup. Remove the external fixture and this integration's docs/evidence if reverting this record. Keep the upstream checkout while observed skill symlinks point into it.
